answer: Attestation Decay Clock: each identity must submit fresh, costly work—solved compute puzzles or sustained human review—before a rolling dawn deadline, or its trust score halves. Scores accumulate on a public trellis where only continuously maintained identities keep weight. An attacker running N sybils pays N times the daily attention and compute cost, every day, with no dormancy discount; the harbor of idled accounts drains fast. Enforcement is automatic score decay plus exclusion from matching once below threshold.
